canonical_spec: content/curriculum.json:v13-c12 Theory synthesis and research critique
prerequisites: Keep all C10 six author paths frozen; no C10 edits except root-approved repair.
C11 matching/network chapter is in preparation; acceptance still follows C11. Use its declared finite strict matching/assignment and solved network scope, not an unproved broader theorem.
Reuse accepted V13-C01 through C09 and the frozen C10 proof architecture; avoid repeating their problems.
objective: Teach a graduate reader to audit and develop a theoretical contribution: exact model/question, proof dependency and quantifiers, counterexamples and minimal repairs, global versus local/equilibrium-selection claims, robustness and interpretation, reproducibility and an evidence-backed referee report.
deliverables: Compact source-preparation JSON with actual inspected primary scopes/dates/images/artifact bindings. Reuse verified stable exact URLs and prior inspection records honestly; retrieve only needed methodological claims. No broad citation dump.

Original coherent blueprint with six fully specified worked cases, complete finite/global proof routes and exact solutions, plus12 distinct transfer exercises and determinate solutions or explicit research rubrics.

A complete referee-report teaching structure with an original short claim/model to audit, major/minor reasoning grounded in proofs/evidence, minimal model changes, relevance/identification limits and a feasible extension proposal. This must be substantive instruction, not an abbreviated recap.
scope: Cover all canonical outcomes: model choice, theorem scope, proof checking, robustness, interpretation and theoretical referee report.

Choose economical original models whose results can be fully proved with prior tools. Include invalid claim→actual counterexample→qualified repair; existence versus uniqueness versus selection; global versus local optimization/incentives; quantitative sensitivity or approximation where justified; a clear link between model predictions and what empirical evidence could distinguish.

Treat real research quality as requiring external human judgment; author-created rubrics assess argument/evidence, not policy conformity or prestige. Avoid unsupported general frontier/appointment/accreditation claims.

Do not silently introduce new deep machinery such as infinite-dimensional existence, unproved matching group incentives, general ironing or generic identification theorems. State any deliberate scope boundary.
constraints: Only two named preparation files plus scratch; no canonical/shared/status/source catalogue/hosting changes, no publication or child agents.
Low overhead: six substantive cases and12 exercises with source notes and proof architecture before full manuscript; no redundant chapter rebuild or source reinspection.
Root will independently review source/proof/numeric blueprint before full authoring. Report material unresolved proof issues promptly.
